set.body:
Scope

Make explicit applicability decisions for Typelevel-quality release machinery under the current 0.1-development promise, then enforce the adopted subset.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Compiler policy decides and documents fatal warnings, unused imports/values, value discard, deprecations, and platform-specific exceptions; adopted flags are warning-clean across compileAll.
- [ ] A deterministic formatting check and any chosen semantic rewrite checks run locally and in CI without producing broad unrelated rewrites.
- [ ] Coverage is measured for the scientific decision surfaces in hrf/design/model/fit; thresholds are scoped and justified rather than using repository-wide vanity percentages.
- [ ] Mutation testing is either adopted for selected critical branches or explicitly deferred with rationale and trigger conditions.
- [ ] MiMa/source-compatibility is explicitly N/A while no stable promise exists, with a recorded trigger for enabling it before a compatibility-bearing release.
- [ ] Compile-negative tests cover genuinely static distinctions such as Lag versus absolute time and basis-space ownership; runtime facts remain typed runtime tests.
- [ ] PR, nightly, and release lanes and their required/non-required status are documented.
- [ ] CI uses pinned toolchains and remote/pinned dependencies rather than unverified sibling checkout resolution.
- [ ] README/module maturity language and release documentation match the actually enforced gates.
set.title: P4.3: adopt compiler, format, coverage, compatibility, and CI release gates
